column1: # Spyro 1 dragon statues: one row per rescue, the source of
#   level        the level holding the statue (--skip-to-level name)
#                RescuedDragonMobyProps; not unique across the game
#   moby_idx     the statue's index in g_LevelMobys (class 250,
#                MOBYCLASS_CRYSTAL_DRAGON); with level, the row identity
#   statue_pos   the statue moby's world position x,y,z
#   pose         --player-pose value: 300 units above the statue, facing it
#                (yaw = rot_z*16 + 2048); the landing triggers the rescue
#   trigger      first VBL with g_Gamestate == GS_Dragon (8)
#   cuts         camera cuts inside the cutscene (VBLs, comma-separated; -
#                or a step change > 700 after a hold
#   end          first VBL after the trigger with g_Gamestate != 8
#   route        extra launch arguments before the pose; - for none. The
#                second Gnorc Gnexus rescue (MAGNUS, after Gnasty's defeat)
#                is reached through the ending chain, which returns to the
# VBLs are measured headless from boot with --skip-to-level (--disc-cache 0);
# a capture that launches the same way reaches the same VBLs.
